text.content:
The Wards open into a Gilded hall built - or reshaped - around whatever now claims it as its own.

GM Notes

Objective: The stairwell down to the next floor is here - whatever holds this room is standing between the party and it.

Milestone: This is where the floor's story comes to a head: A formula for a rogue homunculus conclave to end all suffering - or all resistance - was hidden in the Cisterns below, and someone just found the first ingredient. Its name is Edric Stormcrow, Herald of a rogue homunculus conclave. The stairs down to the next floor are here too - finding them means going through whatever's guarding this room first.

Secret: Hidden here: leverage against a rogue homunculus conclave that the floor's story doesn't want found.

Hazard: A ward etched into the doorway reacts to anyone who isn't already marked as an ally (DC 15 to detect and counter).
